name: rosetta-metered-concurrency
code:
// The scheduler is cooperative and runs the workers on one thread, so
// a turn parked stands in for the two seconds the task asks for.

use IO.Std.write_line
use Ghul.Coroutines

let permits = 3
let workers = 5
// The task has each worker hold its permit for two seconds. Every
// coroutine here runs cooperatively on one thread, so the hold is
// measured in scheduler turns instead.
let holding_turns = 2

let semaphore = SEMAPHORE(permits)

holding() -> int => permits - semaphore.available

worker(id: int) -> COROUTINE is
    await semaphore.acquire()

    write_line("worker {id} acquired, {holding()} holding")

    for _ in 1::holding_turns do
        await pause()
    od

    semaphore.release()

    write_line("worker {id} released, {holding()} holding")
si

for id in 1::workers do
    worker(id)
od

run()
